pending.body: Restore a real migration path for legacy kinetic `_mg` process keys instead of treating them as raw mg/L aliases. The runtime/data structs now only add `serde(alias = "..._mg")` for `decomposer_*`, `aob_*`, `nob_*`, and `comammox_*` in `crates/tank_core/src/types/process.rs:59-111` and `crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs:763-801`, while `parse_process_params_preset()` only renormalizes the plant/algae `*_mg_total` keys in `crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs:1186-1291`. `legacy_process_param_normalization()` no longer returns `LegacyMgPerL` for any renamed kinetic parameter in `crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs:1345-1365`, so a legacy file such as `aob_k_tan_mg = 0.5` is now interpreted as `0.5 mg N/L` instead of the previous `0.025 mg N/L`. The still-stale regression in `crates/tank_data/src/lib.rs:316-335` expecting `aob_k_tan_mg = 200.0` to report `value 10` shows the old 20 L compatibility contract was intended to remain intact.
